name: ecommerce-shipping-filament
description: The operator surface for shipping: where zones, rates, bands and restrictions are authored, and where recorded prices are read.
features: Zone authoring that refuses an ambiguous overlap as form validation naming the conflicting zone
Table-rate band authoring that refuses a gap, an overlap or a missing unbounded top band
Restriction authoring with the recorded reason a buyer will be shown
Recorded prices are read-only through every ability, enforced at the authorization funnel
Rate preview that records nothing and names the operator fault when a zone has no priced rate
Live carrier rating rendered as three distinguishable outcomes, never one empty list
